precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public'
       AND table_name = 'user'
       AND column_name = 'passwordHash'
   ) AS result

SELECT NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM information_schema.columns
     WHERE table_schema = 'public'
       AND table_name = 'user'
       AND column_name = 'password'
   ) AS result
